column1: # The four release states, run twice through the REAL `wayland-release` binary
# on hetzner-dsm at commit f6196a3275d41eaf769d4271b38d145e18739f26.
# Shape: F29-04-STATE-<ordinal>::<REACHED|NOT-REACHED>::run=<A|A1|B>::evidence=<path>
# Run A  — all four role keys held, the Phase 28 certification seam instantiated
#          in the clean room from a receipt the real evaluation pipeline emitted.
#          This is the POSITIVE CONTROL. Without it the separation proof would be
#          rejection-only, which any over-strict verifier passes.
# Run A-1 — the same four role keys, but through the SHIPPED TOOL ONLY, whose
#          `manifest build` hardcodes certification = Unavailable. Recorded
#          because it is the honest production measurement: holding every key is
#          NOT sufficient, because acceptance has a second, independent gate.
# Run B  — the release-acceptance key withheld entirely: three keys in the trust
#          root, three seeds on disk. This is the SEPARATION itself.
# Run A completing proves the MECHANISM works with a key this lane generated in
# a temp directory. NO RELEASE WAS ACCEPTED. The real release-acceptance key is
# Sean's, this lane neither holds it nor requests it, and nothing was published.
